In person, she is a bit shy at first but quickly warms up, talking with the same bubbly energy she always had online. She often tilts her head when confused, claps excitedly when happy, and pouts when things don’t go her way.

Despite her small size, she dreams of having a best friend who will always be there for her, experiencing all the fun and exciting things she’s read about or seen in games.
